title: Monorail outside, rebuilt to your reference
caption: The cars, beam and pillars are now one Blender model made after art/refs/monorail/jorgen-suggestion-20261009.png: weathered stainless with panel lines, a navy skirt and line, dark window frames, roof units, bellows, a chunky beam and rust-streaked pillars. The interior, the doors and play are unchanged.
